about_the_game:
Pathfinder RPG - Pathfinder Flip-Mat: Boardwalk


Down on the boardwalk, there's more than just opportunities for bargains and entertainment, for it's here that your next urban adventure might begin! This line of gaming maps provides ready-to-use and captivatingly detailed fantasy set pieces for the busy Game Master. The next time your players head down to the local waterfront, these maps have you covered. With 
Pathfinder Flip-Mat: Boardwalk
, you'll be ready the next time your players head to the waterfront!



NOTE:  This product has been made specifically for the Pathfinder ruleset, but can be used for Pathfinder 2.0, 5E, Starfinder, Starfinder 2.0 or any ruleset supported by Fantasy Grounds

This product is not a PDF or accessible outside of Fantasy Grounds. It has been lovingly converted for use within Fantasy Grounds and Features the Following additions:



<ul> <li> All maps resized and set up with a preset grid to make combats easy to manage</li>
<li> All the images and handouts from the book available to share with your players as you need them</li>
</ul>"
